hako-code.description: A standalone terminal agent in a single C file. Model agnostic (13 providers + local hako), skill-driven, tool permission gated. No node, no python.

orbit.description: Local-first runtime for coding agents. Agents file tasks, Orbit lands them from sandboxed worktrees, and every step is audited. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Agy and Muse. No telemetry.

mnemoteca.description: Mnemoteca — local memory for every agent

code-evolve.description: A self-evolving project builder. Given a vision and spec, it autonomously builds and improves a project session after session. Just drop it into your existing project and go.

lixbon.description: LLMs auto-hospedados en un clúster GPU distribuido: gateway compatible con OpenAI, web, desktop, CLI y móvil.

airdrop-llm.description: An offline, zero-dependency multi-node pipeline-parallel LLM inference broker. Pools heterogeneous consumer hardware (Apple Metal + NVIDIA CUDA) over ad-hoc local hotspot LANs with an integrated OpenAI-compatible API gateway.

tyloquant.description: Get more intelligence from every bit. Better quantization formats and smarter calibration let larger, stronger models run smoothly on the hardware you already own.

quill.description: Free, open-source voice dictation for Windows. Two hotkeys: one types exactly what you say, the other refines it with a local LLM. Your speech never leaves your device.

iran-mcp.description: 71 MCP servers (883 tools) that give AI agents the Iranian web: Digikala, Torob, Divar, Snappfood, Alibaba, Neshan, Paziresh24, Jobinja, Bama, Codal, laws, tax, crypto, stocks, news and more. Prices in Toman.

wcode.description: Wcode is an engineering control plane for coding agents.

memesh.description: local collaboration layer for AI coding agents

buddy.description: A virtual pet companion for your AI — Designed to provide in-context code review feedback with personality. Grow with your buddy and level up together. Works with Claude Code, Codex, CursorCLI, Github CopilotCLI, OpenClaw, and any MCP compatible clients

mini-diarium.description: A local-only journal with serious encryption. Free, open source, and never touches the internet.

djpdf.description: Create small, searchable PDFs from scanned documents
